Q: Node Reference Returning Null during @onready A:

If the the car is the only one in the scene you also use an unique name. You can access it directly with %

%car

This is a shorthand and works also when you move the node around. No path guessing.

More details:

https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/tutorials/scripting/scene_unique_nodes.html
